vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Ground Elder too.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Vanessa, Vito, Simone and Benjamin met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Vanessa, Vito, Simone are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Vito, Simone, Victor and Petra met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Vito, Victor are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
Hassan: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vanessa just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vanessa, Vito, Simone and Benjamin met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Vanessa, Simone, Benjamin are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Simone just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vanessa, Vito and Simone met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Vanessa, Simone are hurt.
Hassan: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
Ines: "The ground elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vanessa just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Benjamin just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zahid just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vanessa, Vito, Simone, Benjamin and Zahid met them at the door — 5 put down. Vanessa, Vito, Simone, Benjamin, Zahid are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Naran met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Omar just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? David just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Omar, Sanne and David met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sanne, David are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adil just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Adil, Omar and Sanne met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Adil, Omar are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Big Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader The Big Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader The Big Beast!
🛡️ Omar, Sanne and David met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Omar, Sanne, David are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
